clues: This city stands on the shores of San Pablo Bay in California. It is the next-largest town in the North Bay part of the Bay Area.
Summer here runs long, and the seasons lag behind the sun. October days are warmer than May days, though May has more light.
This town was founded in 1851 to be the capital of California. It held that seat for a short time, then the leaders moved on.
The Mare Island navy shipyard rose here in 1854. Its yards shaped the work and life of this town for more than a century.
Six Flags Discovery Kingdom, a park of rides and wild beasts, stands here. It is one of the best-known sights of this bay town.
